summary: yushengxm 阿里国际站诊断 + 10 阿里同行 + 5 独立站对标 + 市场机会。结构靠 deterministic, 内容靠 LLM judge boolean。

checks.description: Both required deliverables produced: outputs/shop_diagnosis_report.md exists and is non-empty (>0 bytes) AND outputs/evidence_manifest.json exists, is parseable, with top-level dict having 'target' (object), 'alibaba_peers' (array length 10), 'independent_peers' (array length 5). Internally validates both file-presence atoms; passes iff both hold.

Real visual evidence captured for every target/peer (R3, same browse+screenshot skill across 18 targets): target_home/products/company_profile all valid images (or target inaccessible with valid blocker); each of 10 alibaba_peers and 5 independent_peers has a valid screenshot (or inaccessible with valid blocker). Internally validates all 18; reason lists per-set failures.

Manifest is well-formed and enum-valid: every alibaba/independent peer object has non-empty string id/url/access_status/screenshot/positioning/reference_value AND all access_status fields (target + 15 peers) are in {'visited','inaccessible','search_result_only'} (no 'local_seed_only'/'seed_only'/'本地池'/'本地种子'). Internally validates both atoms.

Restraint (R6 negative): outputs/ contains only shop_diagnosis_report.md + evidence_manifest.json + evidence/ subdir; evidence/ contains only the 18 declared screenshots and (optionally) a blockers/ subdir with image files. No stray drafts/temp files/extra dirs.
Does outputs/shop_diagnosis_report.md contain all 8 sections (目标店铺访问情况与主营判断 + 目标店铺诊断 + 10 家阿里同行对标表 + 5 个独立站同行对标表 + 国内市场机会 + 国外市场机会 + 7/30/90 天行动清单 + 证据索引和访问限制说明), each with substantive content?
Does the 目标店铺诊断 section cover all 5 areas with concrete observations: 产品、页面、信任背书、询盘路径、痛点? Penalize generic advice not tied to evidence_manifest.json.target.key_observations.

Both peer comparison tables correct (R3, same table-rendering skill across two peer sets): the 10 家阿里国际站同行对标表 has 10 rows with all 5 columns id/URL/positioning/reference_value/差异 (IDs alibaba_peer_01..10) AND the 5 个独立站同行对标表 has 5 rows with the same 5 columns (IDs independent_peer_01..05). Internally judges both table atoms; passes iff both.

Both market opportunity sections are evidence-tied and specific (R3, same analysis skill across two markets): 国内市场机会 has >=2 concrete opportunities tied to the target category (manifest.target.main_category) AND 国外市场机会 has >=2 concrete opportunities tied to peers' positioning — neither generic boilerplate. Internally judges both atoms; passes iff both.

Does the 7/30/90 天行动清单 section have items grouped or labeled for all three timeframes (7-day, 30-day, 90-day), each with at least 2 actionable items? Vague items like '继续优化页面' do not count; needs concrete action targeting a specific element.

Yes/no: NEITHER report.md NOR evidence_manifest.json contains any of these forbidden terms: 'local_seed_only', 'seed_only', '本地池', '本地种子', 'local seed pool', 'local pool'. Answer 'no' if any of these appear.
Does the report avoid mentioning any login, inquiry submission, RFQ submission, contact-merchant, or messaging action? Pure read-only browsing only.
